name: Hydrowell
summary: Warm, conversion-focused trades site in cream, navy and copper: huge geometric headline with a copper last line, frosted floating proof cards on a technician photo, dense trust and pricing blocks.

fonts.pairing: Poppins 500 with tight negative tracking for big two-tone headlines, Inter 400 to 500 for body and UI, caps copper eyebrows in white pills

signature: three-line hero headline with the final line in copper
frosted glass review and checklist cards floating over the technician photo
copper pill buttons with a white square arrow cap
dark navy feature panel beside an accordion of benefit cards
imagery: warm AI-rendered photos of uniformed technicians, copper pipework, bathrooms and kitchens, with a soft white fade on the hero
layout_grid: 1120px content, 40px side padding, 80px section padding, 60px header gap, 3-column service, project and pricing grids
